text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text: Whoa, what happened to Rhein Kraft?! Placing 4th as the overwhelming favorite!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: (I don't... know anymore... I can't win... and I don't know what to do...)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Eh, this sound...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: No way... That can't be... Just now... from my dream...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Is this... a dream too...? Have I already been swallowed whole, and now I'll never...?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: I can't... anymore... Running is impossible now...

text_block_list.name: Old Man Reading Newspaper
text_block_list.text: Let's see, looking at the races over the past year... Team <Ascella>. They were doing so well in the spring, though.

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text: It seems Cesario's departure had a severe impact after all. The team doesn't appear to be doing well.

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text: Indeed. There doesn't seem to be a chance of her returning anytime soon either. But let's hope Rhein Kraft can push through and work twice as hard.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Ugh...!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry, everyone... I'm so sorry...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Hmph, they really just write whatever they please! Nothing but mindless gossip and pathetic whining about how it's all over.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Trainer, Kraft is just like us back then, isn't she? Just like how nothing seemed to go our way after the Japan Derby... She's in the exact same spot.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: We just kept losing, losing, and losing... and then, finally...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Kuh... another total defeat...! So, what did you want to talk to King about, Trainer?
I just wanted... to ask you something.
I just wanted... to ask you something.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: What is with that gloomy face? Things can't possibly get any more depressing than this, can they?
I want to help you win, no matter what. And I'll... do anything it takes!
I want to help you win, no matter what. And I'll... do anything it takes!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Anything...? What is... that piece of paper in your hand...?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: A transfer request... What on earth is the meaning of this?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Are you saying you want to dissolve our partnership? That another team offered to take me in?
Yeah, I thought it wasn't a bad offer. For your sake.
Yeah, I thought it wasn't a bad offer. For your sake.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: 'Not a bad offer'... is that so?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: You are right. If things aren't working, changes must be made. It might very well be better for me. But...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: What about for "us"?!
Us...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Are you truly satisfied with only one of us being rewarded?! With one dream coming true while the other vanishes into thin air?! Are you truly fine with that?!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Can you really stand there and say――
――that THAT is what makes a first-rate duo?!
But, there's nothing else we can...
But, there's nothing else we can...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Is there really nothing?!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Look closer! Is there really, truly not a single thing left?! Open your eyes and look properly!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: With those eyes of yours, tell me――what is it that you see?!
...King.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: That's right, me! When you look at me, do you feel nothing at all?! Say it!
King. Together with you, King...
I want to win a G1 race together with King...!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: See?! There is something! Even when pushed down and battered, that feeling still remains inside, doesn't it?!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Inside of you, and inside of me!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: If you truly think you can throw away the conviction we've held onto all this time, then go ahead and try!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: If you can do it, then King will too! So, what are you going to do... with that paper?!
King, this paper...
I'll return it. I will politely refuse the offer.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu, exactly. If it were so easy to throw these feelings away, we wouldn't be struggling like this in the first place.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: I will do it. In the next race, this time for certain――

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: I didn't abandon myself. And because I stood right back up as King, I finally seized victory at that Takamatsunomiya Kinen...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: I only ever sought to prove my own worth, so to be frank, I don't fully understand Kraft-san's desire to "leave something behind." But...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: If you never throw away those feelings, you will reach your destination. That much is the same. Whether Kraft-san can believe that, however, is up to her.
You're right. ――I will do everything I can to help her, King.
You're right. ――I will do everything I can to help her, King.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Indeed. At this stage, the only one who can reach her heart――is you, Trainer.
Carrying those words in my heart, I went searching for Rhein Kraft. I had to reignite her fire somehow.
I couldn't let it end with Rhein Kraft trapped in a pit of helplessness and despair. I refused to let that happen!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Ah... Trainer-san...
Kraft...
She looked completely exhausted... One glance was enough to see the torment she was going through. I had never seen Rhein Kraft like this.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Um... you see... Well... I... was thinking. I couldn't stop thinking...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Maybe... I've just been pushing myself way too hard.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: The Triple Crown girls are truly magnificent... They're on a completely different level compared to someone reckless like me...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Everyone's always talking about them... About who will win the Arima Kinen, or who is truly number one...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Come to think of it, ever since debut... people were always saying they'd go on to achieve great things...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: They really are incredible...
Sincere praise... but it was merely a roundabout way of tearing herself down for falling short.
The more she repeated those words, the deeper the wounds Rhein Kraft inflicted upon herself became...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Those Triple Crown girls... decades, centuries from now, everyone will still remember their names.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: They'll continue running... forever alive in everyone's hearts...
Rhein Kraft didn't leave room for me to reach out. She was sinking further and further into darkness. Deeper and deeper...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: I... couldn't do it... I couldn't make it... And now, no one is talking about me anymore...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Ten years from now, I'm sure no one will remember who I was. No one will watch. I won't reach a single soul.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: But... I guess that's just how it is.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Winning will only get harder and harder... It's only natural that I won't shine... that I won't leave anything behind...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: That's just who I am... An Uma Musume who won't be remembered by anyone and will leave nothing in the end...!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: That's why! It makes sense for me to just fade away like this――

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ――?! Trainer...-san?
choice_data_list: You're wrong! There's no way that's true!

text_block_list.text: I shouted without thinking... Not just out of raw emotion, but out of my deepest conviction as her trainer.
There is no way you won't leave anything behind! I have always watched and believed in your running!
There is no way you won't leave anything behind! I have always watched and believed in your running!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: But that's... only because you're my trainer, Trainer-san.

That's right. But that's not just favoritism. Since I'm a 
trainer, I've seen so many Uma Musume running. And among them――

That's right. But that's not just favoritism. Since I'm a 
trainer, I've seen so many Uma Musume running. And among them――

I've always thought about your running. Every time I see it, 
I can't help but think more and more about it.

I've always thought about your running. Every time I see it, 
I can't help but think more and more about it.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Yaa……!

――I couldn't forget. 
The shock I felt the first time I saw you run.

――I couldn't forget. 
The shock I felt the first time I saw you run.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Something like this……I'll show you I can handle it!
Yaaaaaaa————!

――I couldn't forget. 
At the 『Hanshin JF』, the way you shined, never giving up.

――I couldn't forget. 
At the 『Hanshin JF』, the way you shined, never giving up.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Start the spurt——Here!
Yaaaaa————!

――I couldn't forget. Your first crown at the 『Oka Sho』. Taking 
the title of Queen of the Cherry Blossoms. And then――

――I couldn't forget. Your first crown at the 『Oka Sho』. Taking 
the title of Queen of the Cherry Blossoms. And then――

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Just like thiiiiiiis————!

――I couldn't forget. How you carved a new path at 
the 『NHK Mile C』 becoming the Pioneer, Rhein Kraft.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: But……but compared to the Triple Crown Uma Musume……

It's true that she is an amazing Uma Musume. She might even 
be one of the most awe-inspiring Uma Musume in history. But――
You won't lose to her!
You won't lose to her!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
But that's……something only 
Trainer-san thinks……
choice_data_list: Since I think about it, it'll remain!
Since I think about it, it'll remain!

text_block_list.text:
Right, if you don't give up, it can be fulfilled. Even if she 
herself has given up――as long as "someone" doesn't give up.

I won't ever forget. You say that 10 years from 
now nobody will remember your running but……

I won't ever forget. You say that 10 years from 
now nobody will remember your running but……

I won't ever let that happen! 
Even if you've given up, I won't!

I won't ever let that happen! 
Even if you've given up, I won't!

From now on, you'll be able to run better than before. You'll win 
more. Even in the Senior class, you can still win lots of G1s.

From now on, you'll be able to run better than before. You'll win 
more. Even in the Senior class, you can still win lots of G1s.

There will be many Uma Musume who will be inspired by you. 
If you don't give up, it'll definitely happen!

There will be many Uma Musume who will be inspired by you. 
If you don't give up, it'll definitely happen!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
But there's no definite 
proof that will happen!

There is! If you don't give up it 
will definitely happen, I know it will!

There is! If you don't give up it 
will definitely happen, I know it will!

On that day, King and I succeeded because we didn't give up. 
And because we won that 『Takamatsunomiya Kinen』――

On that day, King and I succeeded because we didn't give up. 
And because we won that 『Takamatsunomiya Kinen』――

Team ＜Ascella＞ survived, 
and was able to welcome you in.

Team ＜Ascella＞ survived, 
and was able to welcome you in.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Trainer-san and King-san's 『Takamatsunomiya Kinen』 victory……

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: On that day, I……

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Saw it together with Cesario on the street billboards. 『It makes 
you want to join that team, doesn't it?』 is what we talked about.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: And that's because Trainer-san didn't give up……

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Something nobody believed would happen…… 
But, even then……because you didn't give up……

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I'm……here now. 
The reason I'm here……and can run……

Rhein Kraft let that sink in. 
The path she walked together with Team ＜Ascella＞

Because there were so many points where we "didn't give up", 
she was able to forge ahead as a Pioneer.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-san…… 
Do you think……I can do it too?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Can I leave something behind? Like Trainer-san and King-san, 
if I never give up……once more. Once……again!

You can do it for sure! 
You've already brought so many of us together.
choice_data_list: Without a doubt――You'll shine in to the future!!

text_block_list.text:
You can do it for sure! 
You've already brought so many of us together.
choice_data_list: Without a doubt――You'll shine in to the future!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Uuu……! Ugh, uuuu……! 
Trainer-san……Uuu!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Uwaaaaaaaan! 
Uwaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa!

My words reached her. ――I was able to persuade her. 
Everything she had been holding back was finally released.

An overflowing of the feelings that she couldn't 
give up on. That was……the only thing that could 
open up Rhein Kraft's future once again……

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Aah…… Ah……
